title: Gear and Stuff
description: Get full enchantments of gear with one command
body:
### Get full enchantments of gear with one command


# Commands
### For Netherite
**format: _/function gear:netherite/<name>_**

example:

```
/function gear:netherite/sword
```
![sword preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/abe983fbc84247accdd9e71e2de3fb4338bae677.png)
### For Diamond
**format: _/function gear:diamond/<name>_**

example:

```
/function gear:diamond/armor
```
### Tools
**format: _/function gear:<name>_**


example:

```
/function gear:shield
```
![shield preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35c0fd9b261fdb972857641fc42cbc32ebf61521.png)
